integrity: An exact rational, coefficientwise certificate is supplied for each of all 23 nonidentity permutations; the claimed infinite result follows from these finite identities and a separate induction. All facts about prior papers are attributed to inspected sources, with no claim of exhaustive literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: The fixed weak permutation ordering is required in every consecutive block of four, with every earlier block ordered below its successor.
No conclusion is asserted for varying patterns, arbitrary nonmonotone sequences, or block lengths other than four.
No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
title: Four-block order rigidity for Van der Laan sequences
